# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist steering text
  after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on call+result).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run position-counter ids
  session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s `_localTrimFallback` routes the
  kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);
  carriers `[{text:"[Image N]"},{image}]` anchor before the first
  referencing user message or after the tool-result run (never inside
  call/result pairs); the current user message rides images in place
  (I3), each in-place image carrying its `[Image N]` label (issue #195
  F3 — the model can cite what it sees); the per-request cap
  (`images.maxPerRequest`, default 20) drops current-first-then-newest
  with a drop notice (never silent; the app logs drops via `AppLog`,
  issue #195 F4); dangling refs (compaction, cap) resolve to `(image no
  longer available)`, and once a renumbering boundary exists (compaction
  summary, structured marker, local-trim note) AUTHORED history
  citations degrade to that note too — after renumbering an `[Image N]`
  may name a different image, so silent rebinding is never allowed
  (issue #195 F2; generated refs/labels stay content-keyed and fresh).
  Stateless per-request rebuild — determinism, compaction eviction and
  resume come free. Kill switch `images.registry: false` → byte-for-byte
  legacy shape. `agent_loop.dart` applies it in `_buildRequestContext`
  after `transformContext`, before tool-pairing repair.
- `lib/src/trajectory/` — the trajectory ledger core (issue #10): finalized
  session records project into an immutable `TrajectorySnapshot` through
  `TrajectorySnapshotBuilder.append`/`applyEvent` — streamed agent events
  land as synthetic rows keyed `turn\0step` (`u\0turn` for prompts) and are
  replaced when the real record lands; revision grows per append. Record
  kinds (closed set, `TrajectoryCellKind`): system, user, context,
  compacted, message, tool, subtool — a subtool is a
  `TrajectoryToolRecord.parentCallId != null`, which only hosts build
  directly (the builder never nests). Derived state folds once per
  snapshot: `deriveTrajectoryLayout` (turns of Message/Step groups +
  collapsible turn/assistant-run summaries), `deriveTrajectoryTimeline`
  (four modes — `sequence` equal-width slots, `duration` with idle gaps
  compressed out, `time` zero-width wall-clock markers, `actual` real gaps;
  three fixed lanes: 0 system/user/context, 1 message/compacted, 2 tools),
  `trajectoryTimelineFocusIndexes` (selection → visible ledger indexes),
  and `ThrottledTrajectorySearchIndex` (full-text; matches are stable
  record ids). `formatters.dart` holds the shared duration/token/throughput
  formatting; `trajectory_preview.dart` the bounded single-line previews;
  `trajectory_export.dart` the whole-snapshot JSON/Markdown exporters the
  header's copy menu uses. Tool records carry `startedAt` (real launch
  time, distinct from the projected position) so the Gantt/actual
  projections plot true spans. Outbound model requests persist for the
  ledger …

# Pull Request Information

- **Title**: feat(1096): mac size diet — wasm_run_flutter.framework + never-loaded assets, ratcheted
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1096-size-diet` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 9
- **Additions**: +191
- **Deletions**: -36
- **Created**: 2026-10-04T13:54:04Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-04T14:30:50Z

## PR Description

Part of #1096 — slice 2: the cuts slice 1 explicitly deferred (AC4 + direction-3 analog on macOS, owner-decision items untouched). Budget-gate script unchanged; baselines reseeded onto the measured post-cut shape.

## Delivered

### AC4 — macOS app ships without `wasm_run_flutter.framework` (27.1 MB unpacked)
`vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec`: `s.vendored_frameworks` removed. The embedded dynamic framework was a **never-loaded fallback**: the Dart FFI surface resolves via dlsym on the app's own executable — `Runner.xcodeproj` force_loads `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports the `_wire_*` symbols (verified per build by the existing `wasm_run FFI symbol verification` step). `createLibraryImpl` (`vendor/wasm_run/lib/src/ffi/io.dart:50-56`) tries `DynamicLibrary.executable()` first on macOS and `_validateLibrary` checks exactly `wire_compile_wasm` — the symbol the CI gate asserts. So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)
`build-macos.yml` Package step prunes, **before any codesign**:
- `flutter_assets/assets/wasm` — ~47 MB of WASI interpreter modules loaded exclusively through `WasiSandboxShell` (`env_factory_io.dart` routes desktops to the host `Process` shell; every `rootBundle.load('assets/wasm/…')` lives in the mobile-only shell — re-verified on current main). Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

### Same fixture prune on every other shipped web shape (5.6 MB each)
`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

### AC1 ratchet — baselines reseeded onto the post-cut shape
Both `scripts/size_budget` floors rewritten from the **real v1.0.504 release artifacts** with the cuts applied (`--reseed`; script unchanged):
- mac zip: TOTAL 203,341,721 → 111,001,004 B unpacked (**−45.3%**); compressed auto-update zip 75.8 MB → 41.0 MB (**−46%**). DMG shrinks identically.
- extension: TOTAL 78,149,373 → 72,527,489 B (**−7.1%**); compressed 28.3 → 26.4 MB.

Gate proofs (all against the committed floors):
- cut mac zip vs pre-PR baseline: PASS (TOTAL −45.3%, no line grew) — the cut ships green even before the reseed lands
- pre-cut v1.0.504 mac zip vs new floor: **FAIL** — 4 NEW >5% lines (`wasm_run_flutter.framework` 27.1 MB, `python.wasm` 30.4 MB, `coreutils.wasm` 8.4 MB, `coach_anny.glb` 5.6 MB), TOTAL +83.2%
- pre-cut extension vs new floor: **FAIL** — glb NEW >5%, TOTAL +7.8%
- tampered cut zip (main binary +10%): **FAIL** (GREW)
- `size_manifest.py selftest`: 11/11 PASS
- per-line shapes of both cut zips otherwise byte-identical to the shipped releases (only the cut lines + engine-bump drift between v1.0.493 baselines and v1.0.504)

### Not needed (verified, deliberately no diff)
- No `wasm_setup_io.dart` change: with the framework gone, `setUp(override:false)` → `isReachable()` → `executable()` succeeds (static link + exported symbols, CI-gated) → early return. The download path never runs on release or dev builds (force_load applies to both).
- iOS podspec untouched — iOS vendors its own framework slice and statically links it.

## Remaining (owner decisions / later slices, unchanged from the issue)
- AC5: iOS lite flavor vs accept-35 MB (LiteRT/Gemma on-device stack, 35 MB iOS / 45 MB macOS)
- OQ3: `--wasm` (skwasm) spike; App.framework 89–92 MB code-size audit (direction 6)
- mac canvaskit rev-dir inner mirror (web-only shape; needs network trace before cutting — extension/web floors already carry it)
- Known gate floor: NEW-line share is 5% of TOTAL — a future single line under that (e.g. a small asset) regrows silently; the TOTAL line still covers aggregate drift.

## CI note
Per fleet policy this PR does not dispatch or rerun workflows; SM schedules CI.

## Issues/Notes

- **CI failure (root cause)**: head `cc81c735` went red on `build-macos` (Quality gate leg `Build macOS (debug)`). - **Why**: the PR removed `s.vendored_frameworks` from `vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec` (AC4 — drop the 27 MB never-loaded `wasm_run_flutter.framework`). But `Classes/EnforceBundling.swift` still rode in the macOS pod. Its dummy references the flutter_rust_bridge symbols that **only the removed vendored dynamic framework used to satisfy** at the pod-target link step — so the pod target now links against nothing defining them and the build fails before the app ever links.
- **Why no other fix**: re-vendoring anything (`vendored_frameworks` or `vendored_libraries` on the static archive) would either resurrect the 27 MB framework or statically link the rust archive into the pod framework — recreating the bloat AC4 removed. - **Review threads**: thread 1 (re-enable pointer note) was already resolved before this rework (pointer landed at the rm site in `build-macos.yml`). The only open item is the CI-red notice — fixed by this change.

## Approach

TDD (RED → GREEN → full suite), same static-lint style as the existing `wasmrun_restore_budget_test.dart` (the failure is link-time on macOS; this Linux runner cannot run `flutter build macos`, so the guard lints the exact invariant the linker enforces):

It reproduced the failure: `EnforceBundling.swift` flagged as the offending compiled source.

3. Verified the podspec still parses (`ruby -c` → Syntax OK) and no remaining reference to `EnforceBundling` exists in the macOS plugin/app.

|---|---|
| `vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/Classes/EnforceBundling.swift` | **Deleted** — iOS-only mechanism; its undefined FFI references broke the pod-target link once the vendored framework was removed |
| `vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec` | Comment rewritten: documents the header-only macOS pod, the Runner force_load/export symbol source, and the link failure this guards against |
| `test/wasmrun_macos_pod_link_test.dart` | **New** — static lint pinning the linkability invariant (no vendored framework/library; no compiled sources in the macOS pod; Podfile keeps force_load + exported_symbol) |

## Test Coverage

- `test/wasmrun_macos_pod_link_test.dart` — 3/3 PASS (failed 2/3 before the fix, reproducing the exact CI failure mode; the third leg guards the symbol provider).
- `test/wasmrun_restore_budget_test.dart` — 5/5 PASS (unaffected; the XCFramework download block the restore step depends on stays).

Per fleet policy this PR does not dispatch or rerun workflows; the push of this fix produces a new head, which SM validation picks up.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist steering text
  after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on call+result).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run position-counter ids
  session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s `_localTrimFallback` routes the
  kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);
  carriers `[{text:"[Image N]"},{image}]` anchor before the first
  referencing user message or after the tool-result run (never inside
  call/result pairs); the current user message rides images in place
  (I3), each in-place image carrying its `[Image N]` label (issue #195
  F3 — the model can cite what it sees); the per-request cap
  (`images.maxPerRequest`, default 20) drops current-first-then-newest
  with a drop notice (never silent; the app logs drops via `AppLog`,
  issue #195 F4); dangling refs (compaction, cap) resolve to `(image no
  longer available)`, and once a renumbering boundary exists (compaction
  summary, structured marker, local-trim note) AUTHORED history
  citations degrade to that note too — after renumbering an `[Image N]`
  may name a different image, so silent rebinding is never allowed
  (issue #195 F2; generated refs/labels stay content-keyed and fresh).
  Stateless per-request rebuild — determinism, compaction eviction and
  resume come free. Kill switch `images.registry: false` → byte-for-byte
  legacy shape. `agent_loop.dart` applies it in `_buildRequestContext`
  after `transformContext`, before tool-pairing repair.
- `lib/src/trajectory/` — the trajectory ledger core (issue #10): finalized
  session records project into an immutable `TrajectorySnapshot` through
  `TrajectorySnapshotBuilder.append`/`applyEvent` — streamed agent events
  land as synthetic rows keyed `turn\0step` (`u\0turn` for prompts) and are
  replaced when the real record lands; revision grows per append. Record
  kinds (closed set, `TrajectoryCellKind`): system, user, context,
  compacted, message, tool, subtool — a subtool is a
  `TrajectoryToolRecord.parentCallId != null`, which only hosts build
  directly (the builder never nests). Derived state folds once per
  snapshot: `deriveTrajectoryLayout` (turns of Message/Step groups +
  collapsible turn/assistant-run summaries), `deriveTrajectoryTimeline`
  (four modes — `sequence` equal-width slots, `duration` with idle gaps
  compressed out, `time` zero-width wall-clock markers, `actual` real gaps;
  three fixed lanes: 0 system/user/context, 1 message/compacted, 2 tools),
  `trajectoryTimelineFocusIndexes` (selection → visible ledger indexes),
  and `ThrottledTrajectorySearchIndex` (full-text; matches are stable
  record ids). `formatters.dart` holds the shared duration/token/throughput
  formatting; `trajectory_preview.dart` the bounded single-line previews;
  `trajectory_export.dart` the whole-snapshot JSON/Markdown exporters the
  header's copy menu uses. Tool records carry `startedAt` (real launch
  time, distinct from the projected position) so the Gantt/actual
  projections plot true spans. Outbound model requests persist for the
  ledger …

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1227
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1227
- **Title**: feat(1096): mac size diet — wasm_run_flutter.framework + never-loaded assets, ratcheted
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1096-size-diet` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 9
- **Additions**: +191
- **Deletions**: -36
- **Created**: 2026-10-04T13:54:04Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-04T14:30:50Z

## PR Description

Part of #1096 — slice 2: the cuts slice 1 explicitly deferred (AC4 + direction-3 analog on macOS, owner-decision items untouched). Budget-gate script unchanged; baselines reseeded onto the measured post-cut shape.

## Delivered

### AC4 — macOS app ships without `wasm_run_flutter.framework` (27.1 MB unpacked)
`vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec`: `s.vendored_frameworks` removed. The embedded dynamic framework was a **never-loaded fallback**: the Dart FFI surface resolves via dlsym on the app's own executable — `Runner.xcodeproj` force_loads `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports the `_wire_*` symbols (verified per build by the existing `wasm_run FFI symbol verification` step). `createLibraryImpl` (`vendor/wasm_run/lib/src/ffi/io.dart:50-56`) tries `DynamicLibrary.executable()` first on macOS and `_validateLibrary` checks exactly `wire_compile_wasm` — the symbol the CI gate asserts. So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)
`build-macos.yml` Package step prunes, **before any codesign**:
- `flutter_assets/assets/wasm` — ~47 MB of WASI interpreter modules loaded exclusively through `WasiSandboxShell` (`env_factory_io.dart` routes desktops to the host `Process` shell; every `rootBundle.load('assets/wasm/…')` lives in the mobile-only shell — re-verified on current main). Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

### Same fixture prune on every other shipped web shape (5.6 MB each)
`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

### AC1 ratchet — baselines reseeded onto the post-cut shape
Both `scripts/size_budget` floors rewritten from the **real v1.0.504 release artifacts** with the cuts applied (`--reseed`; script unchanged):
- mac zip: TOTAL 203,341,721 → 111,001,004 B unpacked (**−45.3%**); compressed auto-update zip 75.8 MB → 41.0 MB (**−46%**). DMG shrinks identically.
- extension: TOTAL 78,149,373 → 72,527,489 B (**−7.1%**); compressed 28.3 → 26.4 MB.

Gate proofs (all against the committed floors):
- cut mac zip vs pre-PR baseline: PASS (TOTAL −45.3%, no line grew) — the cut ships green even before the reseed lands
- pre-cut v1.0.504 mac zip vs new floor: **FAIL** — 4 NEW >5% lines (`wasm_run_flutter.framework` 27.1 MB, `python.wasm` 30.4 MB, `coreutils.wasm` 8.4 MB, `coach_anny.glb` 5.6 MB), TOTAL +83.2%
- pre-cut extension vs new floor: **FAIL** — glb NEW >5%, TOTAL +7.8%
- tampered cut zip (main binary +10%): **FAIL** (GREW)
- `size_manifest.py selftest`: 11/11 PASS
- per-line shapes of both cut zips otherwise byte-identical to the shipped releases (only the cut lines + engine-bump drift between v1.0.493 baselines and v1.0.504)

### Not needed (verified, deliberately no diff)
- No `wasm_setup_io.dart` change: with the framework gone, `setUp(override:false)` → `isReachable()` → `executable()` succeeds (static link + exported symbols, CI-gated) → early return. The download path never runs on release or dev builds (force_load applies to both).
- iOS podspec untouched — iOS vendors its own framework slice and statically links it.

## Remaining (owner decisions / later slices, unchanged from the issue)
- AC5: iOS lite flavor vs accept-35 MB (LiteRT/Gemma on-device stack, 35 MB iOS / 45 MB macOS)
- OQ3: `--wasm` (skwasm) spike; App.framework 89–92 MB code-size audit (direction 6)
- mac canvaskit rev-dir inner mirror (web-only shape; needs network trace before cutting — extension/web floors already carry it)
- Known gate floor: NEW-line share is 5% of TOTAL — a future single line under that (e.g. a small asset) regrows silently; the TOTAL line still covers aggregate drift.

## CI note
Per fleet policy this PR does not dispatch or rerun workflows; SM schedules CI.

# pr-1227: feat(1096): mac size diet — wasm_run_flutter.framework + never-loaded assets, ratcheted

## Description

Part of #1096 — slice 2: the cuts slice 1 explicitly deferred (AC4 + direction-3 analog on macOS, owner-decision items untouched). Budget-gate script unchanged; baselines reseeded onto the measured post-cut shape.

## Delivered

### AC4 — macOS app ships without `wasm_run_flutter.framework` (27.1 MB unpacked)
`vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec`: `s.vendored_frameworks` removed. The embedded dynamic framework was a **never-loaded fallback**: the Dart FFI surface resolves via dlsym on the app's own executable — `Runner.xcodeproj` force_loads `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports the `_wire_*` symbols (verified per build by the existing `wasm_run FFI symbol verification` step). `createLibraryImpl` (`vendor/wasm_run/lib/src/ffi/io.dart:50-56`) tries `DynamicLibrary.executable()` first on macOS and `_validateLibrary` checks exactly `wire_compile_wasm` — the symbol the CI gate asserts. So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)
`build-macos.yml` Package step prunes, **before any codesign**:
- `flutter_assets/assets/wasm` — ~47 MB of WASI interpreter modules loaded exclusively through `WasiSandboxShell` (`env_factory_io.dart` routes desktops to the host `Process` shell; every `rootBundle.load('assets/wasm/…')` lives in the mobile-only shell — re-verified on current main). Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

### Same fixture prune on every other shipped web shape (5.6 MB each)
`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

### AC1 ratchet — baselines reseeded onto the post-cut shape
Both `scripts/size_budget` floors rewritten from the **real v1.0.504 release artifacts** with the cuts applied (`--reseed`; script unchanged):
- mac zip: TOTAL 203,341,721 → 111,001,004 B unpacked (**−45.3%**); compressed auto-update zip 75.8 MB → 41.0 MB (**−46%**). DMG shrinks identically.
- extension: TOTAL 78,149,373 → 72,527,489 B (**−7.1%**); compressed 28.3 → 26.4 MB.

Gate proofs (all against the committed floors):
- cut mac zip vs pre-PR baseline: PASS (TOTAL −45.3%, no line grew) — the cut ships green even before the reseed lands
- pre-cut v1.0.504 mac zip vs new floor: **FAIL** — 4 NEW >5% lines (`wasm_run_flutter.framework` 27.1 MB, `python.wasm` 30.4 MB, `coreutils.wasm` 8.4 MB, `coach_anny.glb` 5.6 MB), TOTAL +83.2%
- pre-cut extension vs new floor: **FAIL** — glb NEW >5%, TOTAL +7.8%
- tampered cut zip (main binary +10%): **FAIL** (GREW)
- `size_manifest.py selftest`: 11/11 PASS
- per-line shapes of both cut zips otherwise byte-identical to the shipped releases (only the cut lines + engine-bump drift between v1.0.493 baselines and v1.0.504)

### Not needed (verified, deliberately no diff)
- No `wasm_setup_io.dart` change: with the framework gone, `setUp(override:false)` → `isReachable()` → `executable()` succeeds (static link + exported symbols, CI-gated) → early return. The download path never runs on release or dev builds (force_load applies to both).
- iOS podspec untouched — iOS vendors its own framework slice and statically links it.

## Remaining (owner decisions / later slices, unchanged from the issue)
- AC5: iOS lite flavor vs accept-35 MB (LiteRT/Gemma on-device stack, 35 MB iOS / 45 MB macOS)
- OQ3: `--wasm` (skwasm) spike; App.framework 89–92 MB code-size audit (direction 6)
- mac canvaskit rev-dir inner mirror (web-only shape; needs network trace before cutting — extension/web floors already carry it)
- Known gate floor: NEW-line share is 5% of TOTAL — a future single line under that (e.g. a small asset) regrows silently; the TOTAL line still covers aggregate drift.

## CI note
Per fleet policy this PR does not dispatch or rerun workflows; SM schedules CI.

# Rework: fix red `Build macOS (debug)` leg (Quality gate)

## Issues/Notes

- **CI failure (root cause)**: head `cc81c735` went red on `build-macos` (Quality gate leg `Build macOS (debug)`). The link step of the `wasm_run_flutter` pod target failed with **~200 undefined symbols for architecture arm64** (`_drop_dart_object`, `_inflate_*`, `_new_*`, `_wire_*`, …) referenced from `_dummy_method_to_enforce_bundling in EnforceBundling.o`.
- **Why**: the PR removed `s.vendored_frameworks` from `vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec` (AC4 — drop the 27 MB never-loaded `wasm_run_flutter.framework`). But `Classes/EnforceBundling.swift` still rode in the macOS pod. Its dummy references the flutter_rust_bridge symbols that **only the removed vendored dynamic framework used to satisfy** at the pod-target link step — so the pod target now links against nothing defining them and the build fails before the app ever links.
- **Why no other fix**: re-vendoring anything (`vendored_frameworks` or `vendored_libraries` on the static archive) would either resurrect the 27 MB framework or statically link the rust archive into the pod framework — recreating the bloat AC4 removed. The pod target also never needed the dummy: the **Runner** target force_loads `libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports every FFI symbol (`flutter_app/macos/Podfile`, non-Debug; Debug exports all globals), and `package:wasm_run` resolves them via `DynamicLibrary.executable()`. `EnforceBundling` is the **iOS** mechanism (app statically links the pod's vendored framework there; the dummy keeps dead-code stripping from discarding the `wire_*` roots) — iOS podspec is untouched.
- **Review threads**: thread 1 (re-enable pointer note) was already resolved before this rework (pointer landed at the rm site in `build-macos.yml`). The only open item is the CI-red notice — fixed by this change.

## Approach

TDD (RED → GREEN → full suite), same static-lint style as the existing `wasmrun_restore_budget_test.dart` (the failure is link-time on macOS; this Linux runner cannot run `flutter build macos`, so the guard lints the exact invariant the linker enforces):

1. **RED** — added `test/wasmrun_macos_pod_link_test.dart`: fails if the macOS podspec vendors any framework/library, if `macos/Classes/` compiles any source (`.swift`/`.m`/`.c`/…) while doing so, or if the Podfile stops force_loading/exporting the static archive (the provider side). It reproduced the failure: `EnforceBundling.swift` flagged as the offending compiled source.
2. **GREEN** — removed `vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/Classes/EnforceBundling.swift` (header-only pod; `frb.h` stays as the public FFI surface so `pod install` materializes the target) and rewrote the podspec comment to document *why*: the header-only macOS pod, where the symbols actually come from (Runner force_load + exported symbols), the iOS-vs-macOS EnforceBundling distinction, and the exact link error this prevents.
3. Verified the podspec still parses (`ruby -c` → Syntax OK) and no remaining reference to `EnforceBundling` exists in the macOS plugin/app.

## Files Modified

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/Classes/EnforceBundling.swift` | **Deleted** — iOS-only mechanism; its undefined FFI references broke the pod-target link once the vendored framework was removed |
| `vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec` | Comment rewritten: documents the header-only macOS pod, the Runner force_load/export symbol source, and the link failure this guards against |
| `test/wasmrun_macos_pod_link_test.dart` | **New** — static lint pinning the linkability invariant (no vendored framework/library; no compiled sources in the macOS pod; Podfile keeps force_load + exported_symbol) |

## Test Coverage

- `test/wasmrun_macos_pod_link_test.dart` — 3/3 PASS (failed 2/3 before the fix, reproducing the exact CI failure mode; the third leg guards the symbol provider).
- `test/wasmrun_restore_budget_test.dart` — 5/5 PASS (unaffected; the XCFramework download block the restore step depends on stays).
- Full test-core suite (`dart test --exclude-tags llm,browser-ext,perf,pty`, same selection CI runs) — see final comment; `dart analyze` clean on the new test; `dart format` applied.

Per fleet policy this PR does not dispatch or rerun workflows; the push of this fix produces a new head, which SM validation picks up.

- **Why**: the PR removed `s.vendored_frameworks` from `vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec` (AC4 — drop the 27 MB never-loaded `wasm_run_flutter.framework`). But `Classes/EnforceBundling.swift` still rode in the macOS pod. Its dummy references the flutter_rust_bridge symbols that **only the removed vendored dynamic framework used to satisfy** at the pod-target link step — so the pod target now links against nothing defining them and the build fails before the app ever links.
- **Why no other fix**: re-vendoring anything (`vendored_frameworks` or `vendored_libraries` on the static archive) would either resurrect the 27 MB framework or statically link the rust archive into the pod framework — recreating the bloat AC4 removed. The pod target also never needed the dummy: the **Runner** target force_loads `libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports every FFI symbol (`flutter_app/macos/Podfile`, non-Debug; Debug exports all globals), and `package:wasm_run` resolves them via `DynamicLibrary.executable()`. `EnforceBundling` is the **iOS** mechanism (app statically links the pod's vendored framework there; the dummy keeps dead-code stripping from discarding the `wire_*` roots) — iOS podspec is untouched.
- **Review threads**: thread 1 (re-enable pointer note) was already resolved before this rework (pointer landed at the rm site in `build-macos.yml`). The only open item is the CI-red notice — fixed by this change.

## Approach

TDD (RED → GREEN → full suite), same static-lint style as the existing `wasmrun_restore_budget_test.dart` (the failure is link-time on macOS; this Linux runner cannot run `flutter build macos`, so the guard lints the exact invariant the linker enforces):

1. **RED** — added `test/wasmrun_macos_pod_link_test.dart`: fails if the macOS podspec vendors any framework/library, if `macos/Classes/` compiles any source (`.swift`/`.m`/`.c`/…) while doing so, or if the Podfile stops force_loading/exporting the static archive (the provider side). It reproduced the failure: `EnforceBundling.swift` flagged as the offending compiled source.
2. **GREEN** — removed `vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/Classes/EnforceBundling.swift` (header-only pod; `frb.h` stays as the public FFI surface so `pod install` materializes the target) and rewrote the podspec comment to document *why*: the header-only macOS pod, where the symbols actually come from (Runner force_load + exported symbols), the iOS-vs-macOS EnforceBundling distinction, and the exact link error this prevents.
3. Verified the podspec still parses (`ruby -c` → Syntax OK) and no remaining reference to `EnforceBundling` exists in the macOS plugin/app.

## Files Modified

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/Classes/EnforceBundling.swift` | **Deleted** — iOS-only mechanism; its undefined FFI references broke the pod-target link once the vendored framework was removed |
| `vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec` | Comment rewritten: documents the header-only macOS pod, the Runner force_load/export symbol source, and the link failure this guards against |
| `test/wasmrun_macos_pod_link_test.dart` | **New** — static lint pinning the linkability invariant (no vendored framework/library; no compiled sources in the macOS pod; Podfile keeps force_load + exported_symbol) |

## Test Coverage

- `test/wasmrun_macos_pod_link_test.dart` — 3/3 PASS (failed 2/3 before the fix, reproducing the exact CI failure mode; the third leg guards the symbol provider).
- `test/wasmrun_restore_budget_test.dart` — 5/5 PASS (unaffected; the XCFramework download block the restore step depends on stays).

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist steering text
  after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on call+result).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run position-counter ids
  session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s `_localTrimFallback` routes the
  kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);
  carriers `[{text:"[Image N]"},{image}]` anchor before the first
  referencing user message or after the tool-result run (never inside
  call/result pairs); the current user message rides images in place
  (I3), each in-place image carrying its `[Image N]` label (issue #195
  F3 — the model can cite what it sees); the per-request cap
  (`images.maxPerRequest`, default 20) drops current-first-then-newest
  with a drop notice (never silent; the app logs drops via `AppLog`,
  issue #195 F4); dangling refs (compaction, cap) resolve to `(image no
  longer available)`, and once a renumbering boundary exists (compaction
  summary, structured marker, local-trim note) AUTHORED history
  citations degrade to that note too — after renumbering an `[Image N]`
  may name a different image, so silent rebinding is never allowed
  (issue #195 F2; generated refs/labels stay content-keyed and fresh).
  Stateless per-request rebuild — determinism, compaction eviction and
  resume come free. Kill switch `images.registry: false` → byte-for-byte
  legacy shape. `agent_loop.dart` applies it in `_buildRequestContext`
  after `transformContext`, before tool-pairing repair.
- `lib/src/trajectory/` — the trajectory ledger core (issue #10): finalized
  session records project into an immutable `TrajectorySnapshot` through
  `TrajectorySnapshotBuilder.append`/`applyEvent` — streamed agent events
  land as synthetic rows keyed `turn\0step` (`u\0turn` for prompts) and are
  replaced when the real record lands; revision grows per append. Record
  kinds (closed set, `TrajectoryCellKind`): system, user, context,
  compacted, message, tool, subtool — a subtool is a
  `TrajectoryToolRecord.parentCallId != null`, which only hosts build
  directly (the builder never nests). Derived state folds once per
  snapshot: `deriveTrajectoryLayout` (turns of Message/Step groups +
  collapsible turn/assistant-run summaries), `deriveTrajectoryTimeline`
  (four modes — `sequence` equal-width slots, `duration` with idle gaps
  compressed out, `time` zero-width wall-clock markers, `actual` real gaps;
  three fixed lanes: 0 system/user/context, 1 message/compacted, 2 tools),
  `trajectoryTimelineFocusIndexes` (selection → visible ledger indexes),
  and `ThrottledTrajectorySearchIndex` (full-text; matches are stable
  record ids). `formatters.dart` holds the shared duration/token/throughput
  formatting; `trajectory_preview.dart` the bounded single-line previews;
  `trajectory_export.dart` the whole-snapshot JSON/Markdown exporters the
  header's copy menu uses. Tool records carry `startedAt` (real launch
  time, distinct from the projected position) so the Gantt/actual
  projections plot true spans. Outbound model requests persist for the
  ledger …

— must fail before the fix
— cover the exact scenario called out (including boundary/multi-item cases, not just the happy path)"] T2["GREEN: Make the minimum code change to turn the test PASS

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1227
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1227
- **Title**: feat(1096): mac size diet — wasm_run_flutter.framework + never-loaded assets, ratcheted
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1096-size-diet` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 9
- **Additions**: +191
- **Deletions**: -36
- **Created**: 2026-10-04T13:54:04Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-04T14:30:50Z

## PR Description

Part of #1096 — slice 2: the cuts slice 1 explicitly deferred (AC4 + direction-3 analog on macOS, owner-decision items untouched). Budget-gate script unchanged; baselines reseeded onto the measured post-cut shape.

## Delivered

### AC4 — macOS app ships without `wasm_run_flutter.framework` (27.1 MB unpacked)
`vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec`: `s.vendored_frameworks` removed. The embedded dynamic framework was a **never-loaded fallback**: the Dart FFI surface resolves via dlsym on the app's own executable — `Runner.xcodeproj` force_loads `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports the `_wire_*` symbols (verified per build by the existing `wasm_run FFI symbol verification` step). `createLibraryImpl` (`vendor/wasm_run/lib/src/ffi/io.dart:50-56`) tries `DynamicLibrary.executable()` first on macOS and `_validateLibrary` checks exactly `wire_compile_wasm` — the symbol the CI gate asserts. So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)
`build-macos.yml` Package step prunes, **before any codesign**:
- `flutter_assets/assets/wasm` — ~47 MB of WASI interpreter modules loaded exclusively through `WasiSandboxShell` (`env_factory_io.dart` routes desktops to the host `Process` shell; every `rootBundle.load('assets/wasm/…')` lives in the mobile-only shell — re-verified on current main). Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

### Same fixture prune on every other shipped web shape (5.6 MB each)
`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

### AC1 ratchet — baselines reseeded onto the post-cut shape
Both `scripts/size_budget` floors rewritten from the **real v1.0.504 release artifacts** with the cuts applied (`--reseed`; script unchanged):
- mac zip: TOTAL 203,341,721 → 111,001,004 B unpacked (**−45.3%**); compressed auto-update zip 75.8 MB → 41.0 MB (**−46%**). DMG shrinks identically.
- extension: TOTAL 78,149,373 → 72,527,489 B (**−7.1%**); compressed 28.3 → 26.4 MB.

Gate proofs (all against the committed floors):
- cut mac zip vs pre-PR baseline: PASS (TOTAL −45.3%, no line grew) — the cut ships green even before the reseed lands
- pre-cut v1.0.504 mac zip vs new floor: **FAIL** — 4 NEW >5% lines (`wasm_run_flutter.framework` 27.1 MB, `python.wasm` 30.4 MB, `coreutils.wasm` 8.4 MB, `coach_anny.glb` 5.6 MB), TOTAL +83.2%
- pre-cut extension vs new floor: **FAIL** — glb NEW >5%, TOTAL +7.8%
- tampered cut zip (main binary +10%): **FAIL** (GREW)
- `size_manifest.py selftest`: 11/11 PASS
- per-line shapes of both cut zips otherwise byte-identical to the shipped releases (only the cut lines + engine-bump drift between v1.0.493 baselines and v1.0.504)

### Not needed (verified, deliberately no diff)
- No `wasm_setup_io.dart` change: with the framework gone, `setUp(override:false)` → `isReachable()` → `executable()` succeeds (static link + exported symbols, CI-gated) → early return. The download path never runs on release or dev builds (force_load applies to both).
- iOS podspec untouched — iOS vendors its own framework slice and statically links it.

## Remaining (owner decisions / later slices, unchanged from the issue)
- AC5: iOS lite flavor vs accept-35 MB (LiteRT/Gemma on-device stack, 35 MB iOS / 45 MB macOS)
- OQ3: `--wasm` (skwasm) spike; App.framework 89–92 MB code-size audit (direction 6)
- mac canvaskit rev-dir inner mirror (web-only shape; needs network trace before cutting — extension/web floors already carry it)
- Known gate floor: NEW-line share is 5% of TOTAL — a future single line under that (e.g. a small asset) regrows silently; the TOTAL line still covers aggregate drift.

## CI note
Per fleet policy this PR does not dispatch or rerun workflows; SM schedules CI.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist steering text
  after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on call+result).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run position-counter ids
  session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s `_localTrimFallback` routes the
  kept region through the same repairer.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1227
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1227
- **Title**: feat(1096): mac size diet — wasm_run_flutter.framework + never-loaded assets, ratcheted
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1096-size-diet` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 9
- **Additions**: +191
- **Deletions**: -36
- **Created**: 2026-10-04T13:54:04Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-04T14:30:50Z

## PR Description

Part of #1096 — slice 2: the cuts slice 1 explicitly deferred (AC4 + direction-3 analog on macOS, owner-decision items untouched). Budget-gate script unchanged; baselines reseeded onto the measured post-cut shape.

## Delivered

### AC4 — macOS app ships without `wasm_run_flutter.framework` (27.1 MB unpacked)
`vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec`: `s.vendored_frameworks` removed. The embedded dynamic framework was a **never-loaded fallback**: the Dart FFI surface resolves via dlsym on the app's own executable — `Runner.xcodeproj` force_loads `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports the `_wire_*` symbols (verified per build by the existing `wasm_run FFI symbol verification` step). `createLibraryImpl` (`vendor/wasm_run/lib/src/ffi/io.dart:50-56`) tries `DynamicLibrary.executable()` first on macOS and `_validateLibrary` checks exactly `wire_compile_wasm` — the symbol the CI gate asserts. So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)
`build-macos.yml` Package step prunes, **before any codesign**:
- `flutter_assets/assets/wasm` — ~47 MB of WASI interpreter modules loaded exclusively through `WasiSandboxShell` (`env_factory_io.dart` routes desktops to the host `Process` shell; every `rootBundle.load('assets/wasm/…')` lives in the mobile-only shell — re-verified on current main). Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

### Same fixture prune on every other shipped web shape (5.6 MB each)
`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

### AC1 ratchet — baselines reseeded onto the post-cut shape
Both `scripts/size_budget` floors rewritten from the **real v1.0.504 release artifacts** with the cuts applied (`--reseed`; script unchanged):
- mac zip: TOTAL 203,341,721 → 111,001,004 B unpacked (**−45.3%**); compressed auto-update zip 75.8 MB → 41.0 MB (**−46%**). DMG shrinks identically.
- extension: TOTAL 78,149,373 → 72,527,489 B (**−7.1%**); compressed 28.3 → 26.4 MB.

Gate proofs (all against the committed floors):
- cut mac zip vs pre-PR baseline: PASS (TOTAL −45.3%, no line grew) — the cut ships green even before the reseed lands
- pre-cut v1.0.504 mac zip vs new floor: **FAIL** — 4 NEW >5% lines (`wasm_run_flutter.framework` 27.1 MB, `python.wasm` 30.4 MB, `coreutils.wasm` 8.4 MB, `coach_anny.glb` 5.6 MB), TOTAL +83.2%
- pre-cut extension vs new floor: **FAIL** — glb NEW >5%, TOTAL +7.8%
- tampered cut zip (main binary +10%): **FAIL** (GREW)
- `size_manifest.py selftest`: 11/11 PASS
- per-line shapes of both cut zips otherwise byte-identical to the shipped releases (only the cut lines + engine-bump drift between v1.0.493 baselines and v1.0.504)

### Not needed (verified, deliberately no diff)
- No `wasm_setup_io.dart` change: with the framework gone, `setUp(override:false)` → `isReachable()` → `executable()` succeeds (static link + exported symbols, CI-gated) → early return. The download path never runs on release or dev builds (force_load applies to both).
- iOS podspec untouched — iOS vendors its own framework slice and statically links it.

## Remaining (owner decisions / later slices, unchanged from the issue)
- AC5: iOS lite flavor vs accept-35 MB (LiteRT/Gemma on-device stack, 35 MB iOS / 45 MB macOS)
- OQ3: `--wasm` (skwasm) spike; App.framework 89–92 MB code-size audit (direction 6)
- mac canvaskit rev-dir inner mirror (web-only shape; needs network trace before cutting — extension/web floors already carry it)
- Known gate floor: NEW-line share is 5% of TOTAL — a future single line under that (e.g. a small asset) regrows silently; the TOTAL line still covers aggregate drift.

## CI note
Per fleet policy this PR does not dispatch or rerun workflows; SM schedules CI.

# Rework: fix red `Build macOS (debug)` leg (Quality gate)

## Issues/Notes

- **CI failure (root cause)**: head `cc81c735` went red on `build-macos` (Quality gate leg `Build macOS (debug)`). The link step of the `wasm_run_flutter` pod target failed with **~200 undefined symbols for architecture arm64** (`_drop_dart_object`, `_inflate_*`, `_new_*`, `_wire_*`, …) referenced from `_dummy_method_to_enforce_bundling in EnforceBundling.o`.
- **Why**: the PR removed `s.vendored_frameworks` from `vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec` (AC4 — drop the 27 MB never-loaded `wasm_run_flutter.framework`). But `Classes/EnforceBundling.swift` still rode in the macOS pod. Its dummy references the flutter_rust_bridge symbols that **only the removed vendored dynamic framework used to satisfy** at the pod-target link step — so the pod target now links against nothing defining them and the build fails before the app ever links.
- **Why no other fix**: re-vendoring anything (`vendored_frameworks` or `vendored_libraries` on the static archive) would either resurrect the 27 MB framework or statically link the rust archive into the pod framework — recreating the bloat AC4 removed. The pod target also never needed the dummy: the **Runner** target force_loads `libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports every FFI symbol (`flutter_app/macos/Podfile`, non-Debug; Debug exports all globals), and `package:wasm_run` resolves them via `DynamicLibrary.executable()`. `EnforceBundling` is the **iOS** mechanism (app statically links the pod's vendored framework there; the dummy keeps dead-code stripping from discarding the `wire_*` roots) — iOS podspec is untouched.
- **Review threads**: thread 1 (re-enable pointer note) was already resolved before this rework (pointer landed at the rm site in `build-macos.yml`). The only open item is the CI-red notice — fixed by this change.

## Approach

TDD (RED → GREEN → full suite), same static-lint style as the existing `wasmrun_restore_budget_test.dart` (the failure is link-time on macOS; this Linux runner cannot run `flutter build macos`, so the guard lints the exact invariant the linker enforces):

1. **RED** — added `test/wasmrun_macos_pod_link_test.dart`: fails if the macOS podspec vendors any framework/library, if `macos/Classes/` compiles any source (`.swift`/`.m`/`.c`/…) while doing so, or if the Podfile stops force_loading/exporting the static archive (the provider side). It reproduced the failure: `EnforceBundling.swift` flagged as the offending compiled source.
2. **GREEN** — removed `vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/Classes/EnforceBundling.swift` (header-only pod; `frb.h` stays as the public FFI surface so `pod install` materializes the target) and rewrote the podspec comment to document *why*: the header-only macOS pod, where the symbols actually come from (Runner force_load + exported symbols), the iOS-vs-macOS EnforceBundling distinction, and the exact link error this prevents.
3. Verified the podspec still parses (`ruby -c` → Syntax OK) and no remaining reference to `EnforceBundling` exists in the macOS plugin/app.

## Files Modified

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/Classes/EnforceBundling.swift` | **Deleted** — iOS-only mechanism; its undefined FFI references broke the pod-target link once the vendored framework was removed |
| `vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec` | Comment rewritten: documents the header-only macOS pod, the Runner force_load/export symbol source, and the link failure this guards against |
| `test/wasmrun_macos_pod_link_test.dart` | **New** — static lint pinning the linkability invariant (no vendored framework/library; no compiled sources in the macOS pod; Podfile keeps force_load + exported_symbol) |

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist steering text
  after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on call+result).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run position-counter ids
  session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s `_localTrimFallback` routes the
  kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);
  carriers `[{text:"[Image N]"},{image}]` anchor before the first
  referencing user message or after the tool-result run (never inside
  call/result pairs); the current user message rides images in place
  (I3), each in-place image carrying its `[Image N]` label (issue #195
  F3 — the model can cite what it sees); the per-request cap
  (`images.maxPerRequest`, default 20) drops current-first-then-newest
  with a drop notice (never silent; the app logs drops via `AppLog`,
  issue #195 F4); dangling refs (compaction, cap) resolve to `(image no
  longer available)`, and once a renumbering boundary exists (compaction
  summary, structured marker, local-trim note) AUTHORED history
  citations degrade to that note too — after renumbering an `[Image N]`
  may name a different image, so silent rebinding is never allowed
  (issue #195 F2; generated refs/labels stay content-keyed and fresh).
  Stateless per-request rebuild — determinism, compaction eviction and
  resume come free. Kill switch `images.registry: false` → byte-for-byte
  legacy shape. `agent_loop.dart` applies it in `_buildRequestContext`
  after `transformContext`, before tool-pairing repair.
- `lib/src/trajectory/` — the trajectory ledger core (issue #10): finalized
  session records project into an immutable `TrajectorySnapshot` through
  `TrajectorySnapshotBuilder.append`/`applyEvent` — streamed agent events
  land as synthetic rows keyed `turn\0step` (`u\0turn` for prompts) and are
  replaced when the real record lands; revision grows per append. Record
  kinds (closed set, `TrajectoryCellKind`): system, user, context,
  compacted, message, tool, subtool — a subtool is a
  `TrajectoryToolRecord.parentCallId != null`, which only hosts build
  directly (the builder never nests). Derived state folds once per
  snapshot: `deriveTrajectoryLayout` (turns of Message/Step groups +
  collapsible turn/assistant-run summaries), `deriveTrajectoryTimeline`
  (four modes — `sequence` equal-width slots, `duration` with idle gaps
  compressed out, `time` zero-width wall-clock markers, `actual` real gaps;
  three fixed lanes: 0 system/user/context, 1 message/compacted, 2 tools),
  `trajectoryTimelineFocusIndexes` (selection → visible ledger indexes),
  and `ThrottledTrajectorySearchIndex` (full-text; matches are stable
  record ids). `formatters.dart` holds the shared duration/token/throughput
  formatting; `trajectory_preview.dart` the bounded single-line previews;
  `trajectory_export.dart` the whole-snapshot JSON/Markdown exporters the
  header's copy menu uses. Tool records carry `startedAt` (real launch
  time, distinct from the projected position) so the Gantt/actual
  projections plot true spans. Outbound model requests persist for the
  ledger …

# Pull Request Information

- **Title**: feat(1096): mac size diet — wasm_run_flutter.framework + never-loaded assets, ratcheted

- **Branch**: `feat/1096-size-diet` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 9
- **Additions**: +191
- **Deletions**: -36
- **Created**: 2026-10-04T13:54:04Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-04T14:30:50Z

## PR Description

Part of #1096 — slice 2: the cuts slice 1 explicitly deferred (AC4 + direction-3 analog on macOS, owner-decision items untouched). Budget-gate script unchanged; baselines reseeded onto the measured post-cut shape.

## Delivered

### AC4 — macOS app ships without `wasm_run_flutter.framework` (27.1 MB unpacked)
`vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec`: `s.vendored_frameworks` removed. The embedded dynamic framework was a **never-loaded fallback**: the Dart FFI surface resolves via dlsym on the app's own executable — `Runner.xcodeproj` force_loads `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports the `_wire_*` symbols (verified per build by the existing `wasm_run FFI symbol verification` step). `createLibraryImpl` (`vendor/wasm_run/lib/src/ffi/io.dart:50-56`) tries `DynamicLibrary.executable()` first on macOS and `_validateLibrary` checks exactly `wire_compile_wasm` — the symbol the CI gate asserts. So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)
`build-macos.yml` Package step prunes, **before any codesign**:
- `flutter_assets/assets/wasm` — ~47 MB of WASI interpreter modules loaded exclusively through `WasiSandboxShell` (`env_factory_io.dart` routes desktops to the host `Process` shell; every `rootBundle.load('assets/wasm/…')` lives in the mobile-only shell — re-verified on current main). Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

### Same fixture prune on every other shipped web shape (5.6 MB each)
`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

### AC1 ratchet — baselines reseeded onto the post-cut shape
Both `scripts/size_budget` floors rewritten from the **real v1.0.504 release artifacts** with the cuts applied (`--reseed`; script unchanged):
- mac zip: TOTAL 203,341,721 → 111,001,004 B unpacked (**−45.3%**); compressed auto-update zip 75.8 MB → 41.0 MB (**−46%**). DMG shrinks identically.
- extension: TOTAL 78,149,373 → 72,527,489 B (**−7.1%**); compressed 28.3 → 26.4 MB.
